svg.title: Arrakis 1984 — desert storm
svg.desc: Self-contained crimson landscape with animated dust. Moon texture by Solar System Scope, CC BY 4.0, https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/. Texture converted to grayscale, resized, and rendered onto two fictional moons. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Original terrain and dust from scene.js.
